// Part: room: guest bedroom (plan.md ROOMS: Bedroom 8, ground floor, inner air x27..32 z54..60, y4..9).
// Door from the west corridor on the north wall (z53, x29..30); a second way in on the east wall (x33, z56..57).
// The bed is the focal piece, against the south wall opposite the north door. A chest dresser on the west wall, a
// barrel wardrobe on the east wall, a side table with a chair by the window, a red rug, and one hanging lantern.
// Lanes kept clear: x29..30 from z54 to the bed, and x32 z56..57 from the east door.
import { layers, bed } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";

// Rows run along +z (z54..60), columns along +x (x27..32). '.' is left as it is.
const LEGEND = {
  c: ["chest", { facing: "east" }],
  b: "barrel",
  f: "dark_oak_fence",
  T: ["dark_oak_slab", { type: "top" }],
  s: ["dark_oak_stairs", { facing: "west", half: "bottom" }],
  r: "red_carpet",
  k: ["candle", { candles: "2", lit: "true" }],
  L: ["lantern", { hanging: "false" }],
  h: ["lantern", { hanging: "true" }],
  i: ["iron_chain", { axis: "y" }],
  p: "flower_pot",
};

// Layers y4..y9 (index 0..5), each 7 rows (z54..z60) of 6 columns (x27..x32).
const LAYERS = [
  // y4: floor objects
  [
    "c....b", // z54: chest dresser (west), barrel (east)
    ".....b", // z55
    "fs....", // z56: table fence, chair facing west
    "..rrr.", // z57: rug
    "..rrr.", // z58
    "......", // z59
    "b...L.", // z60: barrel under the flower pot, bedside lantern on the floor
  ],
  // y5: things on top faces
  [
    "k....L", // z54: candle on the chest, standing lantern on the barrel
    "......",
    "T.....", // z56: top slab table top
    "......",
    "......",
    "......",
    "p.....", // z60: flower pot on the barrel
  ],
  // y6
  [
    "......",
    "......",
    "L.....", // z56: table lantern on the slab
    "......",
    "......",
    "......",
    "......",
  ],
  // y7
  ["......", "......", "......", "......", "......", "......", "......"],
  // y8
  ["......", "......", "......", "...h..", "......", "......", "......"], // z57: hanging lantern
  // y9
  ["......", "......", "......", "...i..", "......", "......", "......"], // z57: chain to the upper floor
];

export function build(g) {
  layers(g, [27, 4, 54], LEGEND, LAYERS);
  // The bed: foot at (30, 4, 59), head one step south at (30, 4, 60), against the south wall.
  bed(g, [30, 4, 59], "south", "red");
}

The cause is in the shell: it carves all 252 cells of the room to air, and runParts locks air an earlier part placed, so every one of the 22 writes was refused and no free cell was left to move them to.

waste.what: Found why the 22 writes were refused by hand: read runParts' write lock in build.mjs, then wrote a throwaway node script over MCD_PARTS_CELLS output to count which part owns each cell of the room box.
waste.cost: about 4 tool calls plus one full build run; the report's refusedAt was capped at 8 of 22, so the rest I had to recount by reading LAYERS
waste.tool: runParts' report should list every refused cell with its owning part (not the first 8), and `mcd plan`/`mcd room` should flag a room box that is fully owned by an earlier part before the part is written.

waste.what: Counted the 22 refusals by hand against the 20 non-blank layer characters plus the 2 bed cells, to confirm that every write was refused and none could be moved.
waste.tool: A dry-run mode for parts (e.g. `mcd part --dry-run`) that reports, per part, which of its intended cells are owned and which are free, without building the whole shell.

waste.what: The plan says later parts 'only ADD into air' and shell.mjs says the room interior is air, but runParts treats air as owned. That contract conflict made the room unfurnishable and was found only by running the build.
waste.cost: one full build plus the probe script
waste.tool: A check in plan.md/elements.md validation, or a palette/contract test, that confirms a part's target cells are free before the shell is written (or a rule saying the shell leaves rooms unset, not air).

companions.task: Stop filling the room interiors with air. Leave the cells of the guest bedroom (x27..32, z54..60, y4..9) and the other rooms unset so the room part can add furniture into them, or agree a rule that the shell owns only walls and floors. This is the change that unblocks room-6.

Once the shell is fixed, restore the layers() and bed() calls in build() in parts/room-6.mjs and check the room with mcd room and mcd walk. The bed sits against the south wall, with the lanes kept clear.

left: parts/room-6.mjs: the furnishing is withheld (the two calls are commented out, LEGEND and LAYERS kept). The part is not built. Restore it once the shell leaves the room interior unset.

Root cause is outside this part: parts/shell.mjs fills the room interior with air, and runParts (tools/src/build.mjs, owned set) locks air, which contradicts the plan's 'later parts only add into air' rule. Every room part whose interior is shell-air will hit the same refusals.
